module: GE extension `core_vehicle_configTarget`: remembers which vehicle (and which player) is the target of the vehicle configuration menu, so that partmgmt, colors, mirror, thumbnail, etc. do not always act on player 0's vehicle. Also serves as a resolver: resolveVehicleId takes an explicit id, otherwise the target, otherwise player 0's vehicle. Emits onVehicleConfigTargetChanged on every change.
usage:
core_vehicle_configTarget.begin(vehId, {playerId = 0, returnRoute = 'pause.vehicle'})
local id = core_vehicle_configTarget.resolveVehicleId()   -- vehId
core_vehicle_configTarget.clear('done')
notes: returnRoute is only accepted among 'pause' and 'pause.vehicle' (otherwise 'pause.vehicle').
The target is cleared automatically one frame after the vehicle is destroyed if it was not recreated in the meantime (spawn of the same id), at the end of the level or on extension unload.

The read functions (get) return a copy; the onVehicleConfigTargetChanged hook receives (currentTarget, previousTarget, reason) as copies: reason = 'begin', 'clear' or the reason passed to clear ('vehicleDestroyed', 'missionEnded', 'extensionUnloaded').

begin.desc: Sets the target vehicle. Refuses an invalid id or a nonexistent vehicle. Emits onVehicleConfigTargetChanged(current, previous, 'begin').

returns.desc: true if the target was set

clear.desc: Clears the target and emits onVehicleConfigTargetChanged.

reason.desc: reason passed to the hook, default 'clear'

returns.desc: false if there was no target

isActive.desc: Indicates whether a target is set.

getReturnRoute.desc: UI route to return to after configuration.

resolveVehicleId.desc: Determines the vehicle id to use: the explicit id if given and valid, otherwise the target, otherwise player 0's vehicle. Returns nil if the object does not exist.

explicitVehicleId.desc: id imposed by the caller (nil = automatic; an invalid id gives nil, with no fallback)

resolveVehicle.desc: Like resolveVehicleId but returns the vehicle object.

resolveVehicleData.desc: Like resolveVehicleId but returns the data from core_vehicle_manager.getVehicleData.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook: if the target vehicle is destroyed, notes that the target must be cleared on the next frame.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook: cancels the planned clearing if the same id is recreated (vehicle replacement).

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: clears the target if the destroyed vehicle still does not exist.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook: end of the level; clears the target ('missionEnded').

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook: extension unloaded; clears the target ('extensionUnloaded').

onSerialize.desc: Hook: saves the target before a Lua reload.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook: restores the target if its vehicle still exists.
